transcript: Speaker A: Patient ka condition kya hai? [What is the patient's condition?] Speaker B: Sir, BP kam hai aur breathing mein problem hai. [Sir, BP is low and there is a breathing problem.] Speaker A: BP kam hai matlab? Kya reading hai? Systolic batao, diastolic batao, oxygen saturation kya hai? Kuch bhi technical nahi pata tumhe? [What do you mean BP is low? What is the reading? Tell me systolic, tell me diastolic, what is the oxygen saturation? You don't know anything technical?] Speaker B: Sir, machine mein 80 aur 50 dikha raha tha. [Sir, the machine was showing 80 and 50.] Speaker A: 80/50 bolo! Hypotension bolo! SpO2 batao! Ambulance driver ho, itna bhi nahi aata? Kisne diya tumhe license? [Say 80/50! Say hypotension! Tell me SpO2! You are an ambulance driver, you don't even know this? Who gave you a license?] Speaker B: Sir, may I say something? Speaker A: Bol. [Speak.] Speaker B: Sir, the patient is a 55-year-old male. He presented with acute chest pain radiating to the left arm. Onset was approximately 40 minutes ago. He has a history of hypertension, no known allergies. We administered oxygen at 4 liters per minute and positioned him at 45 degrees during transit. BP at the time of pickup was 90/60, current SpO2 is 94%. Speaker A: Raju, tune ye kab seekha? [Raju, when did you learn this?] Speaker B: Sir, teen mahine pehle aapne mujhe sabke saamne bola tha, ambulance log sirf gaadi chalana jaante hain. Us raat bahut bura laga tha. Par gussa nahi kiya, seekhne ka decide kiya. [Sir, three months ago you told me in front of everyone that ambulance people only know how to drive. I felt very bad that night. But I didn't get angry, I decided to learn.] Speaker A: Kaise seekha? [How did you learn?] Speaker B: Sir, English Seekho app download ki. General English show se start kiya. "Hello se baat shuru karein" pehla video 1,65,000 log dekh chuke the. Basic English seekhi, phir medical terms khud practice kiye. [Sir, I downloaded the English Seekho app. Started with the General English show. The first video "Start talking with Hello" was already watched by 1,65,000 people. Learned basic English, then practiced medical terms myself.] Speaker A: Medical English kahan se? [Where did you learn medical English from?] Speaker B: Maine bola, mujhe patient handover dena hai English mein. AI Coach ne sikha diya: "The patient is a male, age approximate, presenting with, history of, no known allergies, vitals at the time of pickup." Ek ek line practice ki. 500 baar galat bola, 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi nahi boli, "Ambulance driver hai, tujhse nahi hoga." [I said, I want to give a patient handover in English. The AI Coach taught me: "The patient is a male, age approximate, presenting with, history of, no known allergies, vitals at the time of pickup." Practiced line by line. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said, "You are an ambulance driver, you can't do it."] Speaker A: Form dikhao kal ka. [Show me yesterday's form.] Speaker B: Sir, ye raha. Chief complaint: Male, 40 years, road traffic accident. Complaint of severe pain in the right leg and abrasion on the forehead. Vitals: BP 130/85 mmHg, SpO2 97%, pulse 92 bpm. Allergies: None reported. First aid: Wound cleaned, splint applied to right leg, oxygen administered at 2 liters per minute. Speaker A: Ye tune likha hai? [Did you write this?] Speaker B: Haan sir. Roz raat ko duty ke baad AI Coach se practice karta hoon. Form likhta hoon, sudharti hai. Handover bolta hoon, correct karti hai. Ab har patient ka handover English mein deta hoon. [Yes sir. Every night after duty I practice with the AI Coach. I write the form, it corrects it. I speak the handover, it corrects it. Now I give every patient's handover in English.] Speaker A: Raju, I owe you an apology. Speaker B: Sir, apology ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas ek request hai, baaki ambulance staff ko bhi English seekhne ka mauka do. English Seekho app hai, General English show se start karein. AI Coach se practice karein, roz 15 minute. Ek mahine mein handover English mein denge. Patient ki care better hogi, aur koi humein sirf gaadi chalane wala nahi bolega. [Sir, no need for an apology. Just one request, give other ambulance staff a chance to learn English too. There is the English Seekho app, start with the General English show. Practice with the AI Coach, 15 minutes daily. In one month they will give handovers in English. Patient care will be better, and no one will call us just drivers.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An ambulance driver is initially shamed by a doctor for not knowing technical medical terms in English. He uses the English Seekho app to learn basic English and practice professional medical handovers with the AI Coach, eventually earning the doctor's respect. The ad encourages viewers to download the app to improve their professional communication.
